entities.name: Ethyl aryl oxyacetate
observations: SELFIES decode as an ethyl 2-(biphenyl/furanyl-aryl oxy)acetate, represented as CCOC(=O)COc1cccc(-c2ccco2)c1.

entities.name: Aryl oxyacetic acid
observations: Product is the corresponding 2-(aryl oxy)acetic acid, represented as O=C(O)COc1cccc(-c2ccco2)c1.

entities.name: Ester saponification
observations: Ethyl ester is converted to the carboxylic acid while the aryl ether and furan ring remain unchanged.
This is ester hydrolysis/de-esterification, not oxidation or aryl deprotection.

entities.name: Aqueous sodium hydroxide hydrolysis
observations: Closest empirical record uses sodium hydroxide and water, with ethanol present or formed, for 4.0 hours and reports 82% isolated yield.
Acidification during workup is implied or required to isolate the carboxylic acid; chloride is listed as a salt component in the record.
